title: Freezing parsed values
text: The CatalogLoader freezes parsed SKU values by calling List.copyOf(values). The method throws NullPointerException when any element is null, and the returned list is unmodifiable.

title: Atomic session cache initialization
text: SessionCache initializes entries with ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent. If the mapping function returns null, computeIfAbsent returns null and records no mapping for that key.

title: Link checker task execution
text: LinkChecker creates its task executor with Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor. Closing that executor waits for all submitted tasks to finish.

title: Service configuration validation
text: The ServiceConfig record validates its endpoint in the compact constructor. A blank endpoint causes IllegalArgumentException.

title: Java build toolchain
text: The build selects JDK 25 with java.toolchain.languageVersion.set(JavaLanguageVersion.of(25)). Java compilation also sets options.release to 25.

title: HTTP retry rules
text: The SDK retries GET and HEAD requests up to three attempts. A POST is retried only when it carries an Idempotency-Key header.

title: Database migration lease
text: The migration coordinator stores its lease in the schema_history_lock table. A lease expires after 90 seconds unless the owner renews it.

title: JSON wire mapper
text: The wire mapper calls findAndRegisterModules so Java time values use registered modules. It disables DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES for forward-compatible input.

title: Mobile view state
text: The mobile client uses MutableStateFlow for view state. Updates use the update function and collectors receive the latest value.

title: Python schema cache
text: The Python worker decorates parse_schema with functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128). Cache invalidation calls parse_schema.cache_clear().

title: Node.js exporter backpressure
text: The Node.js exporter pauses its readable stream when writable.write returns false. It resumes after the writable emits drain.

title: Reporting connection pool
text: The reporting data source allows 12 database connections. Idle connections are retired after 10 minutes.
